sentences.en: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
sentences.zh: 你走后谁来照顾那条狗了?

sentences.en: I cared for the rabbits when I was at school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校的时候负责照看那些兔子。

sentences.en: Send this parcel to him in care of his company.
sentences.zh: 把这包裹寄到他公司的收件人手中。

senses.zh: 小心，照料，忧虑，慎思，焦虑因素
